# Pull request (handbook 19.28 — all fields required)

```text
Task/issue:
Requirement/action IDs:
What changed:
What did not change:
Roles/scopes affected:
Database migration:
Security/privacy impact:
Tests run:
Screenshots or demo evidence:
Known limitations:
Rollback notes:
```

## Reviewer checks (19.28)

- [ ] Matches the approved workflow and task packet
- [ ] Permissions enforced by the backend, not only hidden in the UI
- [ ] Error and recovery states included
- [ ] Audit record present for important actions
- [ ] No sensitive data in logs, screenshots or fixtures
- [ ] No undocumented screens or scope creep
- [ ] Tests prove both allowed and denied behaviour
- [ ] High-impact change (results, admissions, finance, support, awards, regulatory, privileged access) has BOTH developers' explicit approval
